visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A metal shopping cart is pushed through a brightly lit supermarket with grey tiled flooring. Inside, several packs of red tomatoes, mushrooms, a large mesh bag of yellow potatoes, and a potted basil plant in brown paper wrapping are visible. A hand wearing a white smartwatch handles the potato bag. (2) The scene transitions to a modern apartment interior with white walls and blonde wood accents. Two women are in the kitchen; one with light blonde hair leans over a black ceramic stovetop holding a phone, while another in a grey hoodie peels potatoes on a wooden board. (3) Close-up shots focus on a large metal pot filled with a simmering red spicy soup base and green cabbage leaves. Ingredients like whole brown mushrooms, orange carrots, white-and-red crab sticks, and shrimp are added and stirred with a large metal spoon. (4) A branded package for a hot pot soup base with red and black graphics is held up to the camera. The setting is bright with warm indoor lighting. (5) A woman with dark hair and bangs is shown in a tight close-up. She uses a metal spoon to lift a juicy mushroom to her mouth, blows on it carefully, and takes a bite with a look of extreme satisfaction. (6) In a wider shot of the dining area, three hands clink glasses together in a toast over the steaming hot pot. The woman with dark hair holds a wine glass and smiles broadly at the lens. (7) Detailed shots of a bowl containing hot pot ingredients served over white rice. The woman eats a spoonful of rice soaked in the red broth and then holds up a piece of brown tofu to show its solid, hole-free texture to the camera while talking.
